response.justification: Bogdan has extensive software engineering experience, including highly relevant work with geospatial data platforms (GISCollective) and high-throughput distributed systems. However, his recent professional experience heavily leans towards TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang rather than the required modern C++ or Rust. While he has historical C/C++ experience and strong fundamentals in testing and software craftsmanship, the significant gap in recent primary languages makes him a borderline candidate who would require ramp-up time for this specific tech stack.
strengths: Strong background in geospatial data processing and building GIS platforms.
Proven experience developing high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems.
Excellent software craftsmanship practices, including TDD, CI/CD, and automated testing.
concerns: Lack of recent, professional experience with modern C++ or Rust.
Recent roles focus predominantly on web, full-stack, and DLang technologies.
May require significant ramp-up time to meet the primary language requirements of the role.
